exposure: women with excess gestational weight gain
women with recommended gestational weight gain
gestational weight gain above IOM recommendations
cohort: This study included 419,028 women from Texas birth/infant death certificate data from 2005-2009.
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain in obese women was associated with lower gestational diabetes risk but higher risk of pre-eclampsia, Cesarean delivery, and negative neonatal outcomes, particularly in Obesity Class III.
